in_sanskrit.name: भोलनाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lord of the Foolish, Lord of the Stupid, Lord of the Simple, Lord of the Innocent

in_hindi.name: भोलनाथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: स्थानपति भोले के (The Lord of the place for the Foolish, The Lord of the place for the Stupid, The Lord of the place for the Simple, The Lord of the place for the Innocent)

in_tamil.name: போலநாத
in_tamil.long_meaning: அடிக்கையாளர் போலுகள் (The Protector of the Foolish, The Protector of the Stupid, The Protector of the Simple, The Protector of the Innocent)

in_telugu.name: భొలనాధ
in_telugu.long_meaning: దేశిక (Desika) భొల దేశిక (The Lord of the Foolish, The Lord of the Stupid, The Lord of the Simple, The Lord of the Innocent)

in_marathi.name: Bholanath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Foolishness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bholanath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bholanath is a compound name from 'Bhola', meaning foolish or simple, and 'Nath', meaning lord. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as Bholanath due to his playful and mischievous nature.

In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as Bholanath due to his playful and mischievous nature.
